cases.name: the release's own binary passes
a binary whose help and usage errors' words alone differ passes
a usage error whose exit code changed is refused, and no case whose words alone differ
a binary that adds to an old case's output and rewords it passes
a binary with a key removed in an old case's output is refused
a binary with a value changed in an old case's output is refused
a binary with an exit code changed in an old case's output is refused
a binary with a written YAML file's value changed in an old case's output is refused
a binary with a written YAML file's key removed in an old case's output is refused
a binary with a written Markdown file's text changed in an old case's output is refused
a broken scenario and case with no commit saying why are refused, naming both and the remedy
a fix naming the scenario and the case in Changes passes
a fix naming the case by a prefix no other case starts with passes
a fix naming the case by a prefix two cases start with leaves it refused, warning
a fix naming only the scenario leaves the case refused
a breaking change naming only the scenario leaves the case refused
a feat naming the scenario and the case in Changes is refused
a breaking change by its footer naming nothing is refused
a breaking change by its ! naming nothing is refused
a breaking change by its footer naming both passes
a breaking change by its ! naming both passes
a Changes entry naming nothing of the release is a warning
range-from checks nothing for a range of a docs commit
range-from checks a range with a feat
no release tag passes, saying so
a shallow clone stops it
a tag that cannot be checked out stops it
the check leaves no scratch worktree behind
